column3: Reordered vDash panels: orphan → tanks → waiting → suggestions → KPIs → job cards. Tanks now visible without scrolling on 1024×768 tablet.
Added focus logic to renderDrawer: Load In focuses serials chip input, Extraction focuses All button. Only when opening new forms (editId == null).
Reordered Load In fields: Bath → Serials → J/C → Component. Serials now appear before auto-filled fields, reducing operator confusion.
Replaced buttons for disposed baths with single "Fill — new charge" button that opens Bath Fill drawer prefilled with that bath.
Collapsed bath-level suggestions to at most one per bath (red > amber > info ranking). Capped rendered list at 3 rows with "show all (N)" expander.
Disabled result buttons in extraction rows until checkbox is ticked. On tick, Cleared shows as default. No change to what gets saved.
